{
  "name": "agentic-qe-fleet",
  "description": "PACTS-based agentic quality engineering fleet — 11 specialized QE agents, sublinear coverage analysis, chaos/resilience testing, and TDD skills for Claude Code",
  "version": "3.15.10",
  "author": {
    "name": "Agentic QE",
    "url": "https://github.com/proffesor-for-testing/agentic-qe"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/proffesor-for-testing/agentic-qe",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "quality-engineering",
    "testing",
    "qe",
    "tdd",
    "chaos-engineering",
    "coverage",
    "test-generation",
    "claude-code",
    "agentic-qe",
    "pact",
    "mod",
    "function-hooks"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "llm_provider": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "LLM provider",
      "description": "Pins the provider the AQE MCP server routes LLM calls to (sets AQE_LLM_PROVIDER), e.g. claude-code, claude, openrouter, ollama. Leave empty to use llm-config.json / environment auto-detection. Unknown values are ignored with a warning.",
      "required": false,
      "default": ""
    },
    "max_budget_usd": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Per-run LLM budget cap (USD)",
      "description": "Per-run spend cap for metered LLM providers (sets AQE_MAX_BUDGET_USD). 0 = no cap from the plugin (llm-config.json global.maxCostPerRun still applies).",
      "required": false,
      "default": 0,
      "min": 0
    },
    "memory_backend": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Memory backend",
      "description": "hybrid = persist learning to .agentic-qe/memory.db in the project (default). memory = database-free mode: full feature parity, nothing written under .agentic-qe/ (sets AQE_MEMORY_BACKEND).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "hybrid",
      "options": [
        "hybrid",
        "memory"
      ]
    },
    "guardMode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AQE learning-data guard",
      "description": "enforce (default): refuse Bash/Monitor/PowerShell/Write/Edit calls that delete, move, overwrite or truncate .agentic-qe/*.db (-wal, -shm, *.rvf) or run DROP/DELETE FROM/TRUNCATE/ALTER ... DROP against them. notify: allow, but toast and count. off: no checks.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "enforce",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "notify",
        "enforce"
      ]
    }
  }
}
